title: Dark Breath
text: Place a Dark Microcore directly in an element slot. Triggers a 1.5-block-radius cloud for 20 seconds, dealing 1 base damage per second and healing the caster for actual damage dealt. Self-damage grants no healing.
Each Delay adds 20 seconds; each Enhancement adds 1 base damage per second. Infusion seeks entities within 5 blocks, including the caster. Only area bonuses enlarge the cloud.
